DefaultKingpinIconIGAug26.png|Unused default icon made for its [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul]] version (21 August 2026 – Present). }} ==Skin Trivia== *The early appearance closely resembles the [[Overhaul v1.3|Frost Invasion Update]] look of the default skin, as both are towers with pale skin wearing a black suit with a black tie and white shirt that wield a luger pistol with their right hand. ==Update History== *'''17 July 2026''' - [[v2.3.0]] **'''Kingpin''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Kingpin''' continues to visually attack enemies while frozen or stunned. **{{Bug}} When placing a ''Bounty'' on an enemy at Level 6A, the Desert Eagles it wields will float in the air. **{{Bug}} '''Kingpin''' at Level 6B has two sets of pants, making the intended striped pants hard to see. *'''21 August 2026''' - [[v2.7.0]] **Updated the icon for the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]] version of the default skin. {{TowerNavBox}} {{ShadowTOC}}
